items: 【Space Saver】Magnetic shelf for stove Perfect for organizing your spices,holding condiments, no more getting mess or searching for the spice you need while cooking! Shelf for back of stove Keeping all of the small things within close reach and won’t take up valuable counter space. Creates more usable space in your kitchen!

【8 Strong Magnets】8 large magnets cover the entire back area ensures sturdy enough to support and it would be much more securing. Shelf for over the stove clings to the top of the stove so there is no movement or possibility of anything falling off. Great for the gap or flat top ovens.

【Stay in Place】Silicone magnetic shelf for stove hold things on the back of stove securely and in place. your stuff won't fall down to the stove any more when you open and shut the stove door, bump. also helps block things from falling behind the stove.

【Premium Silicone】Magnetic shelf for over the stove is secure and made of thick solid silicone it does not get hot or transfer heat to ingredients stored. Sturdy and wide enough to hold a lot of spices. Its more ideal than a metal one so it could be washed and not rust or get totally gunked up.

【Easy to Clean】Shelf for stove spice rack is flexible, easy lays down and remove for cleaning. heavy silicone able to hold it's shape up and keep your stove clean, it won't slip off the stove top. Great for getting your spices in easy access when cooking. A must have for kitchen organization!
